units_caveat: Recorded cost (as_logged, with a fee block) and price-file cost (the other three baselines, token cost only; fees are not on the price list) are never added. A step with no figure in a baseline's units is 'not computed', never 0. Savings of different steps can overlap; each pipeline's combined figure is the sum of the steps' marginal effects in the order cache, context, routing, with routing priced on the post-context tokens. Every figure is an offline replay on logged requests: quality is not measured.

winners.note: Keep every candidate's result: a winner that fails the quality run is swapped for its runner-up without re-running anything.
